body.message:
Apologies for the delay, and thank you very much for your patience and understanding.

We have checked the availability with our management team. Unfortunately, we are unable to confirm the apartment for a long-term booking, as there are already confirmed short-term bookings scheduled during the requested period. As these reservations have already been confirmed, we are unable to cancel or modify them.

We truly understand that this may be disappointing, especially if you were hoping to stay in the apartment for a longer period, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Thank you once again for your kind understanding and patience.
